crossRefs.note: When those who bore Yahweh’s ark had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.
King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, who were assembled to him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing…
They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt…
When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in Yahweh’s name.
They sacrificed sacrifices to Yahweh, and offered burnt offerings to Yahweh, on the next day after that day, even one…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, who were assembled to him, were before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.
translations.bsb: There, before the ark, King Solomon and the whole congregation of Israel who had assembled with him sacrificed so many sheep and oxen that they could not be counted or numbered.
translations.kjv: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
translations.asv: And king Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, were before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be counted nor numbered for multitude.
